units.summary: Adds a benchmark of Head.filterSeriesAndSortPostings at several input fractions. It is test-only and never runs in production, so a short skim is enough.
units.headline: New benchmark for filterSeriesAndSortPostings across input sizes
units.reason: New benchmark in a _test.go file; cannot affect production behavior.

units.summary: Adds a package-level test hook variable that is nil by default. It is invoked by compactHeadViewLocked before eviction and lets tests inject appends.
units.headline: Adds test-only callback hook before series eviction
units.reason: Nil-by-default testing hook; only tests set it, so production behavior is unchanged.

units.summary: Extracts the block-write and evict loop shared by stale-head and selected-series compaction. It adds an appendID watermark captured before the write, so series that received later samples are not evicted. The loop bound is now inclusive and empty writes are skipped. This decides which series are dropped from the head and tombstoned in the WAL, so data loss is possible if it is wrong.
units.headline: Shared head-view compaction with append-ID watermark guarding eviction
units.reason: Persistence and eviction logic with concurrency semantics and a changed loop bound; wrong behavior can lose samples.
focus: committedAppendID is captured before any block write and is the right watermark when isolation is on
behavior when isolation is disabled: the watermark is 0 and the guard is a no-op
inclusive mint <= maxt loop together with the skip on empty uids does not leave blocks overlapping evicted data
the testing callback global is reset after one use

units.headline: Rename staleIndex to selectedSeriesIndex

units.summary: Generalizes the stale-series ref collection into a filter taking arbitrary postings and a keep predicate. The predicate runs under the series lock, and a nil predicate accepts every series. The stale-specific logic moves to staleSeriesRefsNoOOOData, and the debug log text changes. The old headStaleIndexReader.SortedPostings is removed from this unit; the replacement is in the not-shown headSelectedSeriesIndexReader.SortedPostings.
units.headline: Generalize stale-series filtering into predicate-based filterSeriesAndSortPostings
units.reason: New shared filtering used to pick which series get evicted; the locking and sorting behavior must match the old stale path.
focus: the lock is held only around keep and not during the sort
sortedByRef keeps input order and sortedByLabels stays label-sorted for the index reader
the removed SortedPostings override is replaced by the renamed reader
unresolved refs are dropped and do not produce an error

units.summary: Re-implements staleSeriesRefsNoOOOData on top of filterSeriesAndSortPostings using the shared predicates isSeriesWithoutOOO and isStaleSeries. The predicate matches the old inline OOO and stale-NaN checks.
units.headline: Stale ref collection now delegates to generic filter
units.reason: Refactor with an equivalent predicate (no OOO and stale last value) evaluated under the series lock as before.
